[[/Maps|Non-interactive maps]] | pic2 = [[File:Crystal Overlook abandoned settlement.jpg|196px]] | pic2-text = The abandoned settlement of [[Lannur]]. | pic3 = [[File:Crystal Overlook abandoned settlement graveyard.jpg|196px]] | pic3-text = Lannur's graveyard. | ingame name=Crystal Overlook | game link type 0=explorable | game link num 0=448 }} The [[Crystal Overlook]] is an [[explorable area]] in [[the Desolation]] and takes its name from the nearby [[Crystal Desert]], the destination for [[Elona|Elonian]] pilgrims seeking [[Ascension]]. Parts of the [[Great Pilgrimage]] are repeated through quests in the Desolation as well as both quests and missions in ''[[Guild Wars Prophecies]]''. == Getting there == You can only reach this area by crossing from one of the three adjoining explorable areas: [[the Alkali Pan]], [[the Arid Sea]], or [[The Ruptured Heart]]; it is not connected to any [[outpost]] or [[town]]. You can complete the ''[[Guild Wars Nightfall|Nightfall]]'' storyline without visiting this area, which is the site of a single secondary quest ([[Family Soul]], which requires access to ([[Jedeh's Artifact]]) Mandragors *{{a}} 28 (30) [[Achor the Bladed]] → [[Shattering Assault]] ([[Achor's Daggers]]) ==Notes== *There is a Forgotten Guardian in the northwest corner of the map that allows travel to the Arid Sea (a [[region]] in the Crystal Desert of ''Prophecies''). However, your [[account]] must have access to the Prophecies campaign and your current [[character]] must have completed the [[Sanctum Cay]] mission. Party members who do not meet these conditions will be left behind. *The quest [[Family Soul]] affects the spawns in this area. *There is an ancient structure at the very center of the map, inside the [[Sulfurous Haze]] area. [[Zehtuka's Great Horn]] may be found there, along with a [[Cauldron of Cataclysm|Searing Cauldron]]. *Complete exploration of this area contributes approximately 2.8% to the Elonian [[Cartographer]] title track. *{{Vanquisher|count = 196|low = 190|high = 201}} **Only the central sulfurous area and two sandy areas can be cleared while inside a [[Junundu]]. **Apart from two spots where [[Desert Wurm (NPC)|Desert Wurm]]s and the graveyard where [[Restless Dead (Nightfall)|Restless Dead]] may appear, there are no hidden groups. ** There are a couple of easy to miss Djinn groups directly west of The Ruptured Heart exit. **This area is relatively mild and easy compared to the other areas in the Desolation. ==Trivia== [[File:Crystal Overlook statue in the distance.jpg|right|thumb|Statue in the distance.]] *The [[Lonely Vigil]] seen in the Arid Sea is visible from the Forgotten Guardian's location (see image to the right). *With proper triangulation and examination using the statue as a reference point, it can be shown that the maps do not line up properly, with sections of the Crystal Desert in [[Tyria]] overlapping sections in the other parts of the Desolation. {{Explorable areas in the Desolation}} [[Category:Has Lightbringer bounties]] [[Category:Has Sunspear bounties]] [[Category:Wayfarer's Reverie landmarks]] [[de:Kristallspitze]]
